task: Apply a threshold filter to /home/user/Documents/gradient.png to convert it to pure black and white (threshold value: 128). Export to /home/user/Documents/threshold_result.png (400x200).
task_grounding: Open /home/user/Documents/gradient.png in GIMP. The image is 400x200 pixels containing a horizontal gradient from black on the left to white on the right. Apply a threshold at the midpoint (Colors > Threshold, set threshold to 128) to convert the image to pure black and white. Export the result as /home/user/Documents/threshold_result.png.

Left side pixel is pure black (below threshold)
